title: Specified tower splitting and finite diagonal scalar normalization data
statement: For l, E, S, hS and Presentation p as in the tower projective-line construction, define the specified shifted line comparison, KernelSplittingData, its trace, exchange, sumComparison and scalar, the ordinary finite kernel trace and scalar, KernelFiniteNormalization and finiteNormalization, and KernelScalarNormalization. These are the original definitions of lem-sp-tower-p1-kernel-scalar-normalization, relocated verbatim; splitting morphisms are fixed by unit and hyperplane Chern adjuncts, and all finite squares use the canonical site and composition maps.
